title: Game Script Decompiler { Advanced }
features:
Comprehensive Extraction: Extracts and analyzes all scripts used within any Roblox game to provide a clear view of its underlying code structure.
Basic to Advanced Support: Handles everything from simple local scripts to complex, advanced server-side functions and ModuleScripts.
Developer Insight: Helps developers audit game mechanics, review security setups, or learn how specific features are implemented.
Clean & Readable Output: Converts compiled bytecode into easy-to-read script formats for fast and efficient analysis.
Asset & Logic Mapping: Identifies connected RemoteEvents, RemoteFunctions, and dependent modules used across the game environment.
User-Friendly Interface: Features a streamlined layout with options to search, filter, and organize different script types quickly.
